subject.title: [Feature]: bearer token authentication for proxy servers

question: What pre-Gateway mobile transport-auth contract should OpenClaw support for reverse-proxy deployments?
rationale: This crosses the authentication boundary before Gateway pairing, introduces mobile credential storage/replay, and may involve OIDC browser/app-link token handling, so code alone cannot choose the acceptable product and security contract.

options.title: Approve static-header slice first
options.body: Support Basic/Bearer/fixed-header credentials in setup/manual mobile config with secure storage, TLS-only sending, reset/redaction rules, Android/iOS parity, and leave OIDC for a separate design.

options.title: Design OIDC-first contract
options.body: Pause static header work until maintainers approve a browser-return flow, token ownership model, and platform credential lifecycle for identity-aware proxies.

options.title: Keep proxy auth outside mobile setup
options.body: Document VPN/tunnel/Tailscale Serve or direct Gateway auth as the supported mobile path and close proxy-credential injection work as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Approve static-header slice first
recommendation.body: Support Basic/Bearer/fixed-header credentials in setup/manual mobile config with secure storage, TLS-only sending, reset/redaction rules, Android/iOS parity, and leave OIDC for a separate design.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties steipete to setup-code bootstrap, Gateway auth/protocol, and security-facing contract work that this decision extends.
